messages:
marta_marketing: Heads-up: pilot of the new "Pricing Calculator Lite" is scheduled for next Tuesday. Need final FAQ blurb, two naming options for the middle tier, and webhook routing for leads who request a demo. Draft doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/pricing/lite-calc (comments open).

josh_growth: Naming ideas: 'Growth' vs 'Scale' for mid tier. Also want the calc to surface both monthly estimate and an annual-commit preview. Primary KPI = demo requests / calc starts.

rina_cx: For localization: show VAT-inclusive prices for EU and include a short tooltip "VAT may apply" linking to /help/taxes. Also ensure currency switcher respects browser locale.

marc_sales: Routing rules: if user selects 'Request demo' create a ticket via /webhooks/leads with payload fields: contact_email, estimate_usd, wants_demo_contact. Prefer field names that are easy to map. Also add 'utm_source=pricing_calc_lite' to the payload.

tay_prod: We'll expose wants_demo_contact (bool), estimate_usd (number), and region (string). ETA to wire webhook: Monday EOD. We'll gate behind feature flag pricing_calc_lite.

marta_marketing: Great. Include experiment tagging: experiment=pricing_lite_beta and variant=A/B labels for tier names.

josh_growth: Also propose a quick FAQ entry: "Are these final prices?" -> "The calculator gives an estimate. Final invoices reflect committed usage, discounts, and taxes. Choose 'Request demo' to get a validated quote from sales." Thoughts?

rina_cx: Slight tweak: change "invoices" -> "your pricing" and add link to localized Billing FAQ pages.

marc_sales: For lead scoring: set enterprise_interest true when estimate_usd >= 6000. Also add region mapping so APAC leads route to APAC queue.

tay_prod: We'll include enterprise_interest and region in the webhook. We can implement rate-limited fanout to Salesforce.

marta_marketing: Webinar tie-in: attendees who view the calc should see a slide with a benchmark sentence: "Early tests show improved cost efficiency on common LLM requests compared with baseline stacks." We'll avoid exact percentages until analytics confirm. Add placeholder in deck.

josh_growth: I'll prepare a short AB test script: 50/50 mid-tier name, measure demo CTR and demo-to-oppty conversion.

rina_cx: Suggest two concrete example use cases in FAQ: "Customer support bot" and "Internal knowledge search" with ballpark cost per 1k tokens so prospects can orient. Use ranges, not exacts.

marc_sales: Can marketing add a checkbox in the registration: "I want a sales call" so we can track explicit intent independently of estimate?

tay_prod: Yes, that's what wants_demo_contact is for. We'll wire the checkbox to that field.

release-bot: Reminder: marketing checklist for pricing-lite due 2025-09-15 14:00 UTC. Doc: https://release.redwood.ai/checklists/pricing-lite

marta_marketing: Thanks team. Actions: Tay to confirm webhook mapping Monday, Josh to drop A/B test plan by EOD Fri, Rina to prepare localized FAQ snippets, Marc to confirm enterprise threshold and SDR queue mapping. Ping me if blocked.
